# Neural course illustrations

Eight original AI-generated editorial illustrations created with imagegen on 2026-11-01 for AI PATH. They share the site's cream, violet, lime and turquoise palette. The art represents course topics; it is not a screenshot of software, an experimental result or a scientific diagram.

Each course ID has a 1536 × 1024 WebP and a 640 × 427 responsive rendition. The smaller files are used by the home-page catalogue. The dedicated course page uses both sizes with `srcset`. Delivery encoding and resizing preserve the generated composition.

| Course ID | Illustration |
| --- | --- |
| ml-python | A robot prepares data cubes, a grid and charts. |
| ml | A layered neural-network sculpture on a floating island. |
| ml-data | A table of data, bars and observations. |
| ml-vision | A camera robot examines a flower, toy car and mushroom. |
| ml-text | Book pages sorted into two mood groups. |
| ml-audio | Birdsong, a microphone, waveform and spectrogram. |
| ml-series | A timeline crosses from observations to a translucent forecast. |
| ml-tuning | A robot compares three network configurations at a laboratory bench. |

The original SVG teaching diagrams remain in `assets/neural-courses/` and continue to appear in the selected study plan.
